skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop advanced English language proficiency, particularly in academic and business contexts.
Enhance public speaking skills, including effective use of voice, body language, and visual aids.
Improve critical thinking and independent, creative problem-solving in communication.
Learn to design and deliver effective presentations with logical structure and engaging content.
Enhance cross-cultural communication skills for international business environments.
Promote active learning and continuous skill development.

prerequisite_courses: Tiếng Anh – Kỹ năng Nghe, Nói 3
